_readme: This file shows the snippet to add to your Claude Desktop config.
TWO OPTIONS — pick the one that matches your Claude Desktop version:
OPTION A (Claude Desktop 0.10+, native HTTP — no extra tools required)
Use the 'mcpServers' block under OPTION_A below.
OPTION B (older Claude Desktop — requires Node.js installed)
Use the 'mcpServers' block under OPTION_B below.
Change port 3000 if you changed it in MyStickyMonologues Settings.

OPTION_A_streamable_http._comment: Paste this mcpServers block into claude_desktop_config.json

OPTION_B_sse_via_mcp_remote._comment: Paste this mcpServers block into claude_desktop_config.json (requires Node.js)
